recommended_path: Association (amuta) under the Law of Associations 5723-1963, registered with the Registrar of Amutot (Ministry of Justice)
entity_types: Amuta (association) under the Law of Associations 5723-1963 — legal entity upon registration (Art. 1)

requirements.founders: 2 founders minimum; no citizenship or residency requirement (foreigners can found and serve on the board). Signatures must be made before an Israeli lawyer. Name must be unique with at least 2 alternative names proposed; 3-4 goals defined in the association documents
requirements.local_presence: An Israeli address is required for the amuta — may be the law office where documents are signed; no local-agent requirement beyond the lawyer signature
requirements.documents: Founding documents with goals, member list, unique name plus 2 alternatives, Israeli address, board appointment; signatures before an Israeli lawyer

forms: Registrar of Amutot registration application (paper/online card or post office); no separate online e-filing portal confirmed

fees.source: https://www.lawoffices.co.il (registration guide, fee figure dated April 2015)
fees.note: Old figure — re-confirm at registrar before filing. Attorney fee for document preparation and signature is separate and unverified (typically a few hundred to a few thousand NIS, no official rate).

supersedes: Prior enrich-task claim 'easy, A$150-350 fees + A$500-2,000 attorney' — official fee is 942 NIS (secondary source, 2015); the attorney fee is an additional separate cost, not part of the government fee.
No source confirms repeal of the 1963 Law; 2024 Associations Bill (Amendment — Donation from Foreign Governmental Entity) is context only. The 1963 law must NOT be stated as repealed.
notes: Separate status for charities: 13-b / DSD (charitable institution) status from the Tax Authority is a distinct procedure, not required for tech grants
GfNP: Israel on the official Google for Nonprofits country list, confirmed in _gfnp_audit.json
